parameters.content:
## Instagram Autopilot: weekly AI reel
Every Saturday 12:30 (edit the trigger): 4 recent AI-reframed frames -> AI opener video -> montage with music -> Reel + the same video as a Story -> email.

**Needs**: the posts & stories workflow running for a while (the reel reuses its approved AI reframes), ffmpeg (`ffmpeg_path`), `scripts/render_reel.js`, a font, optional `assets/logo.png` + `assets/end_box.png`, music in `music/` + `music/library.json`.

**Setup**
1. Credentials: Google Gemini (PaLM) API, Header Auth for OpenRouter (Jev), Facebook Graph API, SMTP.
2. Fill in the **Config** node (same values as the other workflow).
3. `dry_run: true` renders the reel and emails a link, nothing is posted.
4. Error workflow -> **Instagram Autopilot - Error Notifier**, then `dry_run: false` and activate.

Cost in production: about $0.5 per week, mostly the 8 s 1080p Veo Lite opener.

### 1. Frames + script
Frames from the last 8 days (then 30 days, then all) that were published with an approved AI reframe; 4 different dishes, 9:16 frames first. Jev picks the opening dish. Gemini 3.1 Pro writes 3 script options; rules first, then Jev scores each one with a "weakest line" language question (averaging missed a single broken line). Nothing passes -> safe fallback script.

### 2. AI opener (Veo 3.1 Lite, image-to-video, 8 s)
Start -> poll 3 times -> download -> Gemini Flash reviews the clip against the source frame -> Jev decides (same dish >= 0.5, quality >= 1.5/3). Rejected / failed / timed out -> the opener is a slow zoom on the real frame.

### 3. Montage (background)
`render_reel.js` runs detached (setsid) because it takes ~2.5-3 min on 4 cores; the workflow polls `done.json`. Sub-pixel zoom with ffmpeg `perspective`, least-used music track, end card with question + call to action. `dry_run: true` stops after this.

### 4. Resumable upload + publish
Meta could not fetch the video from the n8n webhook (HEAD -> 404, no Content-Length/Range, error 2207077). So: container with `upload_type=resumable`, then the bytes are POSTed to the returned rupload.facebook.com URI with the Facebook Graph API credential. Poll up to 5 times, then media_publish.

### 5. Same video as a Story + report
The API has no "share reel to story" sticker, so the video is uploaded again as a Story. Every node on this branch continues on error: a failed story never breaks the published reel. Then permalink + HTML email.
